# Component reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.ts from the component specs. Do not edit. -->

Every CUI component, as `import { Name } from 'cui-svelte'`. Each is compiled to the C call in the heading, every frame. Props are the C parameters and option fields, in snake_case; **bold** props work with `bind:`. CUI's [Components](../../docs/components.md) and [More components](../../docs/components-more.md) pages describe what each one does; their option names are the props here.

237 components. Common props on all of them: `class` and `style` (see [Styling](styling.md)), `tooltip`, and `id` (identity, and findable with `rect_of` and in tests).
